scope: Explicit deterministic skill operations, actual registered capability/file effects and durable task steps; not external model or rollback acceptance
negativeOutcome: Zero leading file effects; one failed operations_validation step with executed:false
positiveOutcome: Two actual file operations execute in order; independent file readback is FINAL; two durable tool steps; task completed
limitations: Structural validation, not full capability JSON Schema validation
Valid actions may still have effects before a later execution failure
No transactional rollback or exactly-once claim
